newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria expects some 160,000 jobless by year-end.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria expects some 160,000 jobless by year-end.

text.p: The number of Bulgarians out of work is expected to jump by another 160,000 or 4.2 percent of the workforce by the end of the year as state companies shed employees as part of restructuring reforms, Social Welfare Minister Ivan Neikov said on Thursday.
Unemployment in February totalled 525,148 or 13.7 percent of the workforce.

"Around 100,000 employees in industrial enterprises and 58,000 in the public services sector will be dismissed as a result of structural changes, rehabilitation programmes and isolation of state firms from credits," Neikov told reporters.

The World Bank has approved a $25 million loan for severance payments and compensation for professional retraining, and a further $80 million has been earmarked for lending in the course of the reform, the minister added.
Bulgaria's jobless in February were, showed National Labour Exchange figures. -- Sofia Newsroom +3592-9814145
